name: request-response-degraded-bluetooth
description: Windowed RPC through a shaped pipe at a degraded-Bluetooth wire (100 kbps, 30 ms one-way): the interactive pattern under the constraint a phone-to-node hop actually has. Latency is now wire-dominated instead of engine-dominated, so the product is how little the protocol adds on top of the physics.
conformance: sent == delivered + timeouts; the reference's send-before-register race (see request-response) is latency-shielded here - the wire's round trip dwarfs the registration gap
